name: video-template-frame-arc-voltage
title: Arc Voltage
description: High-energy beat-synced title frame — white-hot Lichtenberg arcs strike across a graphite-black canvas on a fixed beat grid, each beat triggering a pulse-ring bloom and a strobe-safe flash, with the title punching in on the downbeat.

useCase.query: Use the Arc Voltage Frame template to turn my title into a high-energy beat-synced reveal — white-hot Lichtenberg arcs strike across a graphite-black canvas on a fixed beat grid, each beat triggering an expanding pulse-ring bloom and a strobe-safe localized flash, with the title punching in on the downbeat. Preserve the template's visual signature, use real content, and avoid lorem ipsum or placeholder images.

origin.name: none (original technique composed from public-domain algorithms)
origin.reference: Lichtenberg figures (public-domain electrical/mathematical branching phenomenon) rendered via midpoint-displacement fractal subdivision, a classic procedural-graphics algorithm; palette via Inigo Quilez's public 'cosine gradient' formula (iquilezles.org/www/articles/palettes).

via_skill.name: darkroomengineering/lenis
via_skill.author: darkroom.engineering
via_skill.source_file: concept only — the discrete-arrival easing idea (clamped ease-out-expo, 1.001 - 2^(-10t)); no Lenis source code copied, reimplemented from scratch in vanilla JS/canvas as the shared beat-response curve

provenance.transformation: Original composition, not derived from a static preset: a fixed-BPM beat-grid trigger clock (128 BPM) fires beat events; each beat recurses a fresh Lichtenberg-style branching arc (midpoint-displacement fractal subdivision, public domain) onto canvas, spawns a single expanding pulse-ring bloom, and gates a strobe-safe localized flash (opacity capped at 45%, radial, never full-viewport) — all three driven through one shared clamped ease-out arrival curve for a fast-strike/soft-settle signature. Every 4th beat (the downbeat) is louder and drives the title punch. Arc color sweeps white-hot core to violet corona by distance from the strike origin via an IQ cosine-gradient palette. Built as original canvas/CSS/JS; no upstream source code copied verbatim.
